deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's existing flow
Independent third-party security audit with report and remediation
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
Revenue-share repayment mechanism to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. with Intersect acting as budget administrator by prior agreement
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and includes on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout has invested over $130,000 of its own capital into Phase 1.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months and inclusive of a 3% Intersect administration fee.
Phase 2 is intended to deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, a third-party security audit, and launch amplification.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of all fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The exact revenue-base definition and repayment cadence are not finalized in the proposal and are deferred to M1 contracting with the appointed oversight committee.
The proposal projects 12-month launch targets of 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6M+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets.
All on-chain metrics are stated to be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public M5 dashboard, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.
Anvil claims a track record of 250+ Cardano projects delivered, 456,000+ assets minted, 50,000,000+ ADA staked through Anvil infrastructure, and 267,000+ on-chain transactions.
The proposal states that Anvil and Sellout have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document asks for 4,969,231 ada to fund an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone-gated delivery, Intersect administration, audit and oversight, projected adoption metrics, and a proposed treasury repayment mechanism whose exact revenue-base details are deferred to contracting.
